# Line coverage floors (percent) for the code that makes decisions, checked by CI's coverage
# job (.github/scripts/coverage.py). Raise a floor when coverage rises; never lower one to let
# a change through. Hardware and FFI code is reported but has no floor. The dashboard is
# drawn headless against the demo service (ui::render_tests); its floors keep that running.
#
# Each floor sits about 2 points under what CI measured (in brackets, 2026-11-20), so
# moving a few lines in a refactor passes and dropping a test does not. Take the number from
# this job's table (the JSON report): the HTML report counts lines differently and reads up
# to a point higher. A floor set from a measurement outside CI (marked "local") sits about
# 5 under it: local runs have read about 2.5 points above CI's. Raise it once CI's number is known.
src/mitigation.rs 67          # (69.0) limit, restore, crash recovery, card choice; the rest is the NVML binding
